name: chat-bubbles
description: Chat Bubbles: Claude's replies in soft rounded bubbles, your messages under your name with a corner line, tool calls and code changes folded into one quiet line each, and the folder line under every finished reply.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn Chat Bubbles off to get Claude Code's normal transcript back.

bubbles.title: Chat bubbles
bubbles.description: Draw Claude's replies in rounded bubbles, and your messages under your name with a corner line.

userName.title: Your name
userName.description: Shown above your messages. Shell lines and slash commands show the folder instead.

quietTools.title: Quiet tool calls
quietTools.description: Show each read, search, command and code change, or a run of them, as one line, with no diff. Errors still show in full.

lineUnderReply.title: Line under each reply
lineUnderReply.description: Draw the folder and a corner line, with how long the turn took, under each finished reply.
